sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: Powerex Corp. and Reliant Energy Services, Inc. dispute the scope of appellate jurisdiction over remand orders. The case tests the interaction between statutory removal provisions and the general bar on appealing remands.

sections.heading: What each side wants

sections.heading: What each side says
paragraphs: Powerex argues the bar on review applies only to procedural remands.
Reliant argues the statutory bar prevents review of any remand order.
